exclusion_rule: Exclude owner-designated IDs without reduction absent explicit owner correction, and questions used to select or adjust models, parameters, algorithms, prompts or evidence handling. Pure functional checks, raw export, gold mapping and normal frozen-configuration evaluation do not automatically require exclusion. Judge failed or void runs by actual purpose. Add newly evidenced use in a later version.
